label: ENGINEERING_ONLY
comment: R1-T1-TASL-ENV cross-host check of the G.1b TASL-7 nodes (g1b_crosscheck.py). paper.commit is set at the launch commit to the main commit that carries g1b_crosscheck.py (verify_launch_tasl), as for the G.1b spec; until then it names the signed G.1b paper commit and a launch refuses.
rule: R1-T1-TASL-ENV: the G.1b nodes measured on TASL-7 also run their default parts on TASL-2; the metrics must be identical, else STOP and that node's G.1b is re-measured on TASL-2
